# Aussie Bridge Japan

> Aussie Bridge Japan (ABJ) represents Australian food and drink brands in Japan. We introduce brands to Japanese bars, restaurants and retailers, starting in Nagoya, and work on consignment: the brand keeps ownership of its stock and we earn commission on sales. Based in Queensland, Australia.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.aussiebridgejapan.com/): what we do and how it works, with FAQs
- [Services](https://www.aussiebridgejapan.com/services.html): brand representation, compliance coordination, import and storage, market entry strategy, retail, hospitality
- [Consignment](https://www.aussiebridgejapan.com/consignment-japan.html): how selling on consignment works, who pays what, and who it suits
- [Market entry](https://www.aussiebridgejapan.com/market-entry.html): why entering Japan is hard without local help, and how we handle it
- [Book a free 15-minute call](https://www.aussiebridgejapan.com/book-consultation.html)
- [Contact](https://www.aussiebridgejapan.com/contact.html): hello@aussiebridgejapan.com
- [日本語](https://www.aussiebridgejapan.com/ja/): for Japanese buyers and venues
